_meta.note: B + 4 categories adapted from the nuReasoning long-tail taxonomy (Fig. S1). Emergency Vehicle was already present in B and is unchanged. The added categories are behaviour-triggering types (how other road users / traffic controls act) rather than the environment types that B already covers.
